The average weather of a place over a long period, usually at least 30 years.
Wet-and-dry bulb thermometer (hygrometer); the difference between the readings is looked up in a humidity table.

front: Which way does a wind vane point?
back: Into the wind: to the direction the wind comes FROM. Winds are named by where they come from.
Oktas: eighths of the sky covered (0 = clear, 8 = overcast).

front: Mean daily temperature and daily range

back: White (reflects sun), louvred sides (air flow, no direct sun), legs about 1.2 m (away from ground heat), double roof, door facing away from the sun.
Open (away from buildings and trees), level, grass-covered, fenced and easy to reach; read at the same time daily.
